pieces.Text: You have learned transformative secrets from communing with elemental beings.

Whenever you use a polymorph effect to assume the form of an elemental you gain a rush of vital energy. You gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the caster level of the polymorph effect and you gain a +10 foot bonus to your base speed.

Situational.text: Prerequisite: Worshiper of an elemental lord.
